name: Ashes: Undertow
summary:
Ashes Undertow is a semi linear 7 map campaign that tells the story of the nascent scavenger Porcelain as she searches for the mythical Northern Line, a way to bypass the worst of the irradiated ruins of Atlanta. Navigate new faces in a familiar but changed world, and beware: some choices have consequences!

Porcelain has a new set of agility focused movement options and an arsenal that includes 6 new guns including but not limited to: the deadly semi automatic Riot Gun, the stylish .357 Magnum, and the makeshift soda can grenade launching Popgun. Get ready to blast a new set of enemies as well... and potentially a much more serious nemesis who stalks in the shadows.
